verdict.rationale: Wave documents automatic bank feeds on the Pro Plan, where transactions are imported, merged and categorized into the books. Its own built-in payments are stated to connect to its accounting feature. Payroll exists as a native Wave service, but nothing shows payroll activity posting to the ledger automatically, and there is no evidence of connecting external payment or payroll systems. Missing for 10: evidence that payroll entries sync into the ledger, connectors for third-party payment processors and payroll providers, bank feeds outside the paid Pro tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically

citations.quote: Connect your bank accounts in seconds with the Pro Plan. Transactions will appear in your bookkeeping automatically
With the Pro Plan, automatically import, merge, and categorize your bank transactions.
Your invoicing and payment information are connected to Wave's accounting feature, helping you stay organized.
